prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished comparison board of FOUR distinct logo concepts for "Upstream", a welcoming curated learning and knowledge-sharing app. Landscape board, four equal quadrants on a solid warm ivory background, generous whitespace, subtle separators. Each quadrant shows a large symbol beside the exact wordmark "Upstream" in refined friendly humanist sans-serif, and beneath it a small dark slate rounded-square app icon using the same symbol in pale blue. Flat vector-like graphic design, crisp solid fills, no texture, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D. Dark slate primary ink with muted river-blue accents. Broad, thoughtful, quietly confident, approachable rather than corporate IT. Four DIFFERENT silhouettes: top left "01 Confluence": two smooth flowing tributary strokes gracefully joining into a single ascending stream, balanced simple abstract symbol; top right "02 Current": two gently sweeping parallel rising ribbons suggesting forward flow, compact and calm; bottom left "03 Source": an abstract open U with a small emerging upward stream integrated into its shape, a memorable friendly lettermark; bottom right "04 River": one bold softly winding upright river shape with elegant negative space, stable compact silhouette. All four must look distinct and readable at favicon sizes. No circuit nodes, code brackets, network diagrams, mountains, trees, water droplets, generic arrowheads, books, graduation caps, or literal landscape illustrations. Restrained curves and rounded ends, visually simple marks. Labels exactly as provided and wordmark spelled U-p-s-t-r-e-a-m. Only labels and wordmarks; no extra text. This is a professional concept comparison sheet, not a screenshot of an app.
corrective_edit_prompt: Correct this logo comparison board. Replace the entire cloudy dark background with perfectly solid warm white #F7F5F0. Remove ALL glow, haze, gradients, shadows and texture everywhere. Preserve the four logo shapes, positions, app icon tiles, wordmarks and labels exactly. Make all large wordmarks and quadrant labels solid very dark slate #20313C so they are clearly legible. Make large symbols flat solid muted blue #507F98. Small app icon tiles remain solid dark slate with flat pale blue symbols. Crisp flat graphic design on white paper. No atmospheric effects whatsoever.
